desc: The Midwest Industries Slim Line M-LOK handguard is a one-piece design that is machined from 6061 aluminum with a hard coat anodized finish. It features a full length Picatinny top rail and M-LOK mounting slots on 7 flats along its length. The handguard is fully dehorned for user comfort, and is a slim and sleek design with an outside diameter of 1.5" and inside diameter of 1.3". It comes equipped with two anti-rotation QD sling swivel sockets, one 5-slot accessory rail and comes with all required mounting hardware.
